title: Chevrolet S-10 Engines by Year (1982–2004)
description: Every factory engine in the Chevrolet S-10 pickup by year, 1982–2004: the 1.9, 2.0, 2.2 and 2.5 fours, the Isuzu diesel, the 2.8 V6 and the 4.3 Vortec V6.
intro: Chevrolet's compact S-10 pickup ran from 1982 to 2004 in two generations; four-wheel-drive versions were badged T10 at first. The S-10 Blazer SUV is not included.
Pick a year to see every engine offered that model year, with its code, rated horsepower and the trims it came in. Each engine links to its full specs.
The first S-10 used GM's 1.9 and 2.0 fours, the Iron Duke 2.5, a 2.2 Isuzu diesel for 1984–1985 and the 2.8 V6. The 4.3 V6 arrived during 1988, with a high-output version from 1992.
The second S-10 offered the 2.2 four and the 4.3 Vortec V6 in standard and high-output form. The last 2004 trucks were Crew Cab 4x4s with the 4.3.

method: Every engine and year listed here was confirmed by at least three independent sources: the NHRA Stock Car Classification Guides, factory material such as GM Heritage Center information kits and sales brochures, EPA records and established references. Several Wikipedia articles count as one source. Where sources give different ratings, the factory figure is shown and the difference is noted. Factory race-only packages need two sources.
